description: Single source of truth for golden-journey replay fixture expectations. Consumed by BOTH the required unit test (tests/unit/golden-journey-harness/replay-fixtures.test.ts, in-process via evaluateReplayFixture) and the advisory replay-gate script (scripts/ci/golden-journey-replay-gate.sh, out-of-process via the CLI --json-summary). Do not encode these expectations a third time. Exit codes (harness index.ts): 0 = no gating fail, 1 = >=1 gating fail, 2 = fatal (malformed fixture, fail-closed), 3 = auth/preflight/deploy halt (live only). `expected_failing_invariants` pins the exact sorted set of invariant IDs with status 'fail' (gating AND advisory): an advisory classifier that silently stops failing on a mixed-invariant RED fixture is invisible to the exit code alone. Values are CAPTURED, never hand-authored — re-capture with: pnpm tsx tools/golden-journey-harness/index.ts --replay tools/golden-journey-harness/fixtures/<file>.json --out /tmp/r.md --json-summary /tmp/s.json ; then copy failing_invariants. A legitimate classifier/budget change surfaces here as a manifest diff — update it deliberately in the same PR, with the diff explained.
